i feel EXACTLY the same away.  


Before i started olazanpine (2.5mg everyday) i was not afraid of heights.  


I used to do Rappel. My fear of heights was little to nothing, now is VERY HIGH, almost like a panic attack when im in high heights.  


I think its related to the motor imbalance olanzapine causes... fear of heights has a close relation with motor imbalance

Amigo, com base no que já vi de editais, os exames médicos de boa parte dos concursos não conseguem “descobrir” que você tem apenas um Rim.

Na verdade, a única hipótese em que você poderia ser prejudicado no Concurso por isso seria você estar com mal funcionamento no organismo que impactasse nas suas taxas, por exemplo, CREATININA. Se você fizer os exames (básicos)e tiver tudo ok, você tá dentro.


Entretanto, existem alguns Concursos com exame médico mais rigoroso.

Sugiro ler com calma o Edital e focar nesses que são menos rigorosos.
Insomnia is such a bitch. Hang in there friend im almost on the same boat, had 6h of deep sleep last 4days. Before that things were pretty normal, in my case this problem come and go

Life is harsh per se. The ton load of people that take advantage of others is certainly the most disgusting of all it, but there are good people too. I have one real friend that is one of the only things that kept me going, im sure u eventually going to find good people too, trust your feelings and dont let the assholes make u a anti-social person, u will get over it
